versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the SEO Content Engine skill.
- Provides an end-to-end SEO content workflow: keyword research, SERP analysis, outline creation, and draft writing with on-page SEO best practices.
- Includes strategies for creating new articles, refreshing old content, and building content calendars.
- Offers checklists for SEO and content quality, advanced techniques (Skyscraper, intent matching, content clusters), and content refresh strategies.
- Features templates for meta titles/descriptions and highlights common mistakes to avoid.
- Suggests integration ideas and connections to other Content Creator Suite tools.
